title: ICNN-enhanced 2SP: Leveraging input convex neural networks for solving two-stage stochastic programming
abstract: arXiv:2505.05261v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Two-stage stochastic programming (2SP) offers a basic framework for modelling decision-making under uncertainty, yet scalability remains a challenge due to the computational complexity of recourse function evaluation. Existing learning-based methods like Neural Two-Stage Stochastic Programming (Neur2SP) employ neural networks (NNs) as recourse function surrogates but rely on computationally intensive mixed-integer programming (MIP) formulations. We propose ICNN-enhanced 2SP, a method that leverages Input Convex Neural Networks (ICNNs) to exploit linear programming (LP) representability in convex 2SP problems. By architecturally enforcing convexity and enabling exact inference through LP, our approach eliminates the need for integer variables inherent in the conventional MIP-based formulation while retaining an exact embedding of the ICNN surrogate within the 2SP framework. translated_title: ICNN增强的两阶段随机规划：利用输入凸神经网络求解两阶段随机规划问题
translated_abstract: 两阶段随机规划（2SP）为不确定性条件下的决策建模提供了基础框架，但由于追索函数求值的计算复杂性，其可扩展性仍然是一个挑战。现有的基于学习的方法，如Neural Two-Stage Stochastic Programming（Neur2SP），采用神经网络（NN）作为追索函数的代理模型，但依赖于计算开销高昂的混合整数规划（MIP）公式。我们提出了ICNN增强的2SP方法，该方法利用输入凸神经网络（ICNN）来挖掘凸2SP问题中线性规划（LP）的可表示性。通过在架构上强制保证凸性并借助LP实现精确推理，我们的方法消除了传统基于MIP的公式中固有的整数变量需求，同时将ICNN代理模型精确地嵌入到2SP框架中，从而带来了计算效率更高的方案。
tldr: 本文提出ICNN增强的两阶段随机规划方法，利用输入凸神经网络在架构上强制凸性并通过线性规划实现精确推理，从而摆脱对混合整数规划中整数变量的依赖，显著提升求解效率。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes ICNN-enhanced 2SP, which leverages input convex neural networks to enforce convexity architecturally and enable exact inference via linear programming, eliminating the need for integer variables and significantly improving computational efficiency over MIP-based approaches.
